body_ref.description: content-id of the body (canonical JSON of own field values)

class.description: canonical URI of the class object (no selectors)

class_version.description: content-id of the class version used

kind.description: definition | system | raw_document (ledger entries use DAT-LedgerEntry)

predecessor.description: content-id of the previous version on the same branch line, absent for creation

provenance_ref.description: content-id of the derivation record for logic-produced versions (STD-TXN-030)

schema_version.description: schema version of the class at write time

state.description: lifecycle state, when the class has a lifecycle

tombstone.description: true when this version ends the object (ended, or hidden on a child branch)

valid.description: valid-time period; Definition kind only, else {from: null, to: null}
